title: Red Wine Braised Beef Shin — Mash on Saturday, Pappardelle Ragù on Sunday
description: One slow oven braise, two dinners: beef shin, mushrooms and red wine served with mash and green beans on Saturday, then shredded into a ragù over pappardelle on Sunday. Garlic optional.

ingredients.name: Saturday — floury potatoes, peeled and chunked

steps.title: Prep and season the beef
steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C (fan 150°C). Pat the beef dry and season with 1 tsp of the salt and the pepper.

steps.title: Sear the beef in batches
steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large lidded ovenproof casserole over high heat. Sear the beef in 2–3 batches, about 4 min per batch, until well browned. Don't crowd the pot. Set aside on a plate.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Lower to medium. Add the onions, carrots and celery with the remaining ½ tsp salt and cook 10 min, scraping up the browned bits, until soft and golden. Add the garlic for the last minute if using.

steps.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps.text: Push the vegetables aside, add the mushrooms and cook 7 min until they've released their water and started to colour.

steps.title: Toast paste, flour and paprika
steps.text: Stir in the tomato paste, flour and paprika and cook 2 min, stirring constantly so the paprika doesn't burn.

steps.title: Deglaze with wine
steps.text: Pour in the wine and let it bubble 4 min until reduced by about half.

steps.title: Braise in the oven
steps.text: Return the beef and juices. Add the stock, bay leaves and thyme — liquid should come about three-quarters up the meat. Bring to a simmer, cover and braise in the oven 2 h 30 min, then uncover and braise 30 min more to thicken. Done when the beef falls apart under a fork.

steps.title: Saturday: boil the potatoes
steps.text: During the last 30 min of braising, cover the potatoes with cold salted water, bring to the boil and simmer 18–20 min until completely tender. Drain and steam-dry 2 min.

steps.title: Saturday: mash and beans
steps.text: Warm the milk with the butter and mash into the potatoes; season. Boil or steam the green beans 5 min until just tender.

steps.title: Saturday: serve half the braise
steps.text: Remove the bay leaves and thyme stalks. Ladle out half the braise (beef ~60% Matthias, ~40% partner). Mash about 470 g / 120 g, beans 180 g / 120 g, sourdough for Matthias.

steps.title: Cool and refrigerate the rest
steps.text: Cool the remaining half for up to 1 hour, then cover and refrigerate. Keeps 3 days.

steps.title: Sunday: shred and reheat the ragù
steps.text: Lift off any set fat. Shred the beef in the pot with two forks and reheat over medium-low 15–20 min, stirring now and then. Add a splash of water if too thick to coat pasta.

steps.title: Sunday: cook the pappardelle
steps.text: Boil the pappardelle in well-salted water 6–8 min (check the packet). Save a mug of pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Sunday: toss and serve
steps.text: Toss the pasta through the ragù with a splash of pasta water until glossy. Pasta 140 g dry Matthias / 35 g partner, ragù split 60/40. Parmesan 15 g / 5 g, rocket on the side.

notes: Macros shown are Saturday's. Sunday (ragù pappardelle): Matthias ~1,280 kcal, 109 g protein, 125 g carbs, 33 g fat; partner ~605 kcal, 62 g protein, 43 g carbs, 18 g fat. No protein bridge needed either night. Start around 15:30 on Saturday for dinner around 19:30; Sunday takes about 25 min. Kifli swap: if shin is out, use beef cheeks (marhapofa, allow 3.5 h) or chuck (marhalapocka).
